Summary,Sessions run hourly for 9:00–18:00,mix of models (7B,13B,quant),observed that:
- KV cache hits reduce p50/p90 by ~25-35ms for small sequences.
- Partial hits still helpful but inconsistent when KV spans shards.
- Quant models (quant-7B) show lower cost with ~10-20% higher p50 in some long seq cases.
- Batching (batch>=8) reduces p90 at cost of p50 increase for micro requests.

Quick-interpretation: The best immediate lever for reducing p99 is ensuring KV cache locality (avoid cross-shard KV). For cost reduction while keeping latency <200ms, prefer quant-7B for seq<=512 with batch sizes 4-8.
quick_notes: Morning: hot restart at 08:45; first run cold. Midday: noticed CPU steal on a13 nodes at 14:00 — correlates with p99 spike. Afternoon: micro API at 18:00 shows excellent cost profile. Need to validate quant accuracy on targeted prompts (diff checks).
